empirical_trigger_audit.interpretation: Repository-level scheduled Actions are functioning, but the target workflow did not produce the expected scheduled run. This rules out a repository-wide schedule outage but does not prove one unique platform-side cause.

problem_elimination_pass.final_goal: Reliably capture prospective official E-layer disclosures once per calendar day without introducing polling, retries, duplicate research runs or any change to research semantics.
hard_constraints: Run prospective V2.8.4 to V2.8.12 collection once per calendar day.
Preserve the three-calendar-day overlapping scan window.
Preserve announcement_id deduplication and append-only observation semantics.
Preserve V2.8.4 classifier, triage, identity and effective-date rules.
Preserve serialized v284-v2812 prospective E shadow processing.
Do not open outcome research, price/return research, fold3/fold4, Setup, First60, Episode, live execution or brokerage execution.
problem_elimination_pass.soft_assumption_removed: The daily run must start at minute 00 of the hour.

platform_evidence.finding: Scheduled events can be delayed at high-load times including the start of every hour, and under sufficiently high load some queued jobs may be dropped; GitHub recommends scheduling at a different minute of the hour.

problem_elimination_pass.replacement: Run once every calendar day at 01:17 UTC (09:17 Asia/Shanghai). The workflow-file schedule edit also forces the target schedule definition to be re-registered from the default branch.
deleted_actions: No duplicate workflow added solely as a watchdog.
No manual run may be counted as empirical schedule confirmation.

unchanged_research_semantics: V2.8.12 shadow event identity and recurrence semantics
Human Decision Gate and Human Review Packet boundaries
